DOTWORKS is a living office tower on Robinhood Chain, staffed by painted dots.

Every wallet holding at least 1,000 $DWORKS gets its own dot. After one hour in the lobby it is hired and takes a desk. The more a wallet holds, the bigger its dot. The longer a dot keeps its desk, the higher it climbs: Intern, Associate, Senior, Manager, Director, Partner.

Every night at 00:00 UTC the tower ranks its dots by time-weighted balance and hands out corner offices, window desks, plant desks, and cubicles. Dots write morning memos, gossip at the watercooler, and work in weekly teams that holders vote on with a free signature.

Everything is computed from public on-chain data. The site never asks for approvals or transactions.

Not affiliated with Robinhood.
